primary_goal: Drive product discovery and direct users into product detail pages or brand category collections.

friction_points.issue: Missing direct add-to-cart or quick-view interactions on product cards across carousels.
friction_points.evidence: Product cards throughout the page (e.g. Massimo Dutti in screen 2, Coach in screen 4, Rituals in screen 9) only display a wishlist heart icon and price, forcing users to click through to product detail pages to take purchase intent actions.

friction_points.issue: Language inconsistency with English CTAs on a German website.
friction_points.evidence: Screenshots 5 and 12 show sponsored banners for PayPal and The Ordinary with English CTA buttons reading 'Discover' while the surrounding headline copy is in German ('Aktuell im Trend: Später zahlen', 'Lippendefinition. Garantiert.').

friction_points.issue: Hero top fold lacks a clear primary seasonal campaign banner or high-contrast value proposition.
friction_points.evidence: Screenshot 1 shows the top section starting directly with user-generated Instagram-style content under 'Get the Look - Die neueste Auswahl' rather than a high-converting seasonal campaign banner with a bold CTA.

friction_points.issue: Monotonous section pattern creates visual fatigue during scrolling.
friction_points.evidence: Screenshots 2 through 16 repeat an identical layout sequence (sponsored brand header banner -> horizontal product carousel) multiple times (Massimo Dutti, Coach, Gabor, Rituals, Vans, Tom Tailor, The Ordinary, Armedangels).

friction_points.issue: App promotion banner lacks a clickable action button.
friction_points.evidence: Screenshot 6 displays the 'Hast du unsere App ausprobiert?' banner with a 5-star rating graphic, but offers no button to download or open the app, only a close 'X' icon.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we translate all English CTA buttons on sponsored banners to German ('Jetzt entdecken'), then CTA click-through rate will improve because language consistency reduces cognitive hesitation for German shoppers.
hypotheses.change: Change all 'Discover' CTA buttons on sponsored modules (e.g. PayPal, The Ordinary) to 'Jetzt entdecken'.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we add a quick-view or quick-add option on hover for product carousel cards, then add-to-cart rate will increase because purchase friction and navigation steps are reduced.
hypotheses.change: Implement a hover CTA ('Größe wählen' / 'In den Warenkorb') on product cards across homepage carousels.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we add a direct 'App herunterladen' CTA button to the app promo banner, then app install conversion rate will improve because users have a clear next step.
hypotheses.change: Include a prominent 'Jetzt App laden' CTA button inside the app banner on screenshot 6.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we place a prominent seasonal category hero banner above the UGC 'Get the Look' feed, then hero engagement and category click-through rate will increase because users receive immediate value direction.
hypotheses.change: Swap top fold visual priority to feature a key campaign (e.g. Winter Mäntel / Neuheiten) followed by UGC content.

quick_wins: Replace untranslated 'Discover' CTA buttons with German 'Jetzt entdecken' on PayPal and The Ordinary banners.
Add an explicit CTA button ('App öffnen' / 'App downloaden') to the App evaluation banner.
uncertainties: Whether product carousels are dynamically personalized based on individual user browsing history.
The actual conversion contribution of influencer 'Get the Look' boards vs standard category links.
Performance differences between mobile web/app layout vs the desktop view rendered.
